x-values.verify: judge a change: did it work and break nothing (before and after snapshots, or a change set) (default)
x-values.describe: what a change set edits, whether it was predicted, which of its checks got worse
x-values.impact: how far a change reaches, measured: difference areas, subnet connectivity, BGP sessions and route and next-hop counts, and Forward's own ARP, MAC, NAT, L3 route, vulnerability and routing-loop diffs (device adds per-prefix and per-device route changes); judges nothing
x-values.list: the change sets this network holds, each with its predicted snapshots (none is an answer; an unlicensed organization is a licence limit)
x-values.scope: what of this network Predict can model on this release: license facet, every predict flag, out-of-scope BGP families, platforms where propagation stops, SD-WAN devices (Viptela, IOS-XE in SD-WAN mode) and whether PREDICT_MODEL_OMP is on
x-values.preflight: the Predict demo checklist: scope plus release, base snapshot age, existing change sets and BGP advertisement collection
x-values.paths: the GUI's interesting paths: sampled paths through firewalls and load balancers, ranked by score with their stages and path query; on a snapshot (after_snapshot_id) or a change set's predicted snapshot
x-values.ai_summary: Forward AI explains a difference in words (opt-in; generated text, labelled): summary_kind config, impact (default), failure or overview, on a change set or any two snapshots; unknown when the organization has AI off
x-values.history: a change set's saved versions (note, who, when), its summary and the directory it is filed in
x-values.config: one device's configuration in a change set: the draft, or a saved version (commit_id)
x-values.affected: the devices a prediction changed, for a predicted snapshot (after_snapshot_id)

summary_kind.description: view ai_summary only: which Forward AI summary (config: what changed in the configurations; impact: what the change does; failure: why checks fail; overview: a name, description and tags for a change set)

commit_id.description: views history and config: one saved version of the change set (the commit id from view history)
